mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_EVENT WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND END_DATE >= SYSDATE

SELECT E.EVENT_NO , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.START_DATE , E.END_DATE , C.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , A.FILE_PATH , A.CHANGE_NAME FROM CT_EVENT E JOIN CT_EVENT_CATEGORY C ON (E.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO) LEFT JOIN CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT A ON (A.REF_BNO = E.EVENT_NO AND A.FILE_LEVEL = 0 AND A.STATUS = 'Y') WHERE E.STATUS = 'Y' AND E.END_DATE >= SYSDATE ORDER BY E.EVENT_NO DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM CT_EVENT WHERE STATUS = 'Y' AND END_DATE < SYSDATE

SELECT E.EVENT_NO , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.START_DATE , E.END_DATE , C.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , A.FILE_PATH , A.CHANGE_NAME FROM CT_EVENT E JOIN CT_EVENT_CATEGORY C ON (E.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO) LEFT JOIN CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT A ON (A.REF_BNO = E.EVENT_NO AND A.FILE_LEVEL = 0 AND A.STATUS = 'Y') WHERE (E.STATUS = 'Y' AND E.END_DATE < SYSDATE) OR E.STATUS = 'N' ORDER BY E.EVENT_NO DESC

SELECT E.EVENT_NO , E.CATEGORY_NO , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.EVENT_CONTENT , E.START_DATE , E.END_DATE , E.VIEW_COUNT , E.STATUS , E.USER_NO , M.USER_ID , C.CATEGORY_NAME , A.FILE_NO , A.ORIGIN_NAME , A.CHANGE_NAME , A.FILE_PATH , A.FILE_LEVEL , A.STATUS AS FILE_STATUS FROM CT_EVENT E JOIN CT_EVENT_CATEGORY C ON (E.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO) JOIN CT_MEMBER M ON (E.USER_NO = M.USER_NO) LEFT JOIN CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT A ON (A.REF_BNO = E.EVENT_NO) WHERE E.EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND E.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY A.FILE_LEVEL ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_EVENT SET VIEW_COUNT = VIEW_COUNT + 1 WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT CATEGORY_NO categoryNo , CATEGORY_NAME categoryName FROM CT_EVENT_CATEGORY ORDER BY CATEGORY_NO ASC
SELECT FILE_NO fileNo , REF_BNO refBno , FILE_PATH filePath , CHANGE_NAME changeName , FILE_LEVEL fileLevel , STATUS FROM CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo} AND STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT FILE_NO fileNo, REF_BNO refBno, ORIGIN_NAME originName, CHANGE_NAME changeName, FILE_PATH filePath, FILE_LEVEL fileLevel, STATUS FROM CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT WHERE REF_BNO = #{eventNo} AND STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_LEVEL ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE FILE_NO = #{fileNo}
UPDATE CT_EVENT SET STATUS = 'N' WHERE EVENT_NO = #{eventNo}
mapper.select: SELECT E.EVENT_NO , E.EVENT_TITLE , E.START_DATE , E.END_DATE , C.CATEGORY_NO , C.CATEGORY_NAME , A.FILE_PATH , A.CHANGE_NAME FROM CT_EVENT E JOIN CT_EVENT_CATEGORY C ON (E.CATEGORY_NO = C.CATEGORY_NO) LEFT JOIN CT_EVENT_ATTACHMENT A ON (A.REF_BNO = E.EVENT_NO AND A.FILE_LEVEL = 0 AND A.STATUS = 'Y') WHERE E.STATUS = 'Y' AND E.START_DATE <= SYSDATE AND E.END_DATE >= SYSDATE ORDER BY E.MAIN_EXPOSE DESC, E.VIEW_COUNT DESC, E.EVENT_NO DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY
